parameters.query: SELECT c.id as certId, c.equipment, c.tag, c.serialNumber, c.rigId, r.name as rigName, ca.expiryDate, ca.fileName, ca.status, tc.name as certType, DATEDIFF(DAY, GETDATE(), ca.expiryDate) as daysUntilExpiry FROM certificates c JOIN rigs r ON r.id = c.rigId JOIN certificateAttachments ca ON ca.certificateId = c.id LEFT JOIN typeCodes tc ON tc.id = c.typeCodeId WHERE ca.expiryDate IS NOT NULL AND ca.expiryDate >= GETDATE() AND ca.expiryDate <= DATEADD(DAY, 90, GETDATE()) ORDER BY ca.expiryDate ASC

parameters.query: =INSERT INTO notifications (title, message, status, assignedAs, userId, createdAt, updatedAt) SELECT 'Certificate expiring: {{ $json.equipment }}', 'Expires {{ $json.expiryDate }} ({{ $json.daysUntilExpiry }} days) on {{ $json.rigName }}', 'unread', 'cert_manager', u.id, GETDATE(), GETDATE() FROM users u JOIN userRigs ur ON ur.userId = u.id WHERE ur.rigId = {{ $json.rigId }} AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.enabled = 1
